description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat luksoze te zones se TEG, dhe ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 61.5 m2. Hapesira eshte e organizuar me nje planimetri drejtkendore dhe shperndarje te rregullt. Hyrja ne apartament eshte e organizuar nepermjet korridorit i cili te percjell ne njerin krah ne dhomen e ndenjes dhe ambientit te gatimit, ndersa ne krahun tjeter per tek dhoma e gjumit.
Apartamenti ka dhe ballkonin e tij te aksesuar nga salloni i ndenjes.
Apartamenti shitet i investuar perfshire mobilimin si ne foto.
Objekti eshte i termoizoluar me sistem kapote dhe fasade me pllaka terrakote te cilesise me te larte. Dritaret termoizoluese jane me xham triplex dhe kane shtrirje te gjatesise deri ne dysheme, perfshire grila elektrike.
Objekti ka parkun e tij qendror vetem per banoret e rezidences, si dhe hapesira te bollshme parkimi. Rezidenca eshte e rrethuar dhe do te kete monitorim te hapesires me kamera 24 ore ne dite.
Objekti ka akses te menjehershem ne rruget e shpejtesise perreth, si dhe ndodhet fare prane qendres tregtare TEG.
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the luxurious residences of the TEG area, and has a total area of ​​61.5 m2. The space is organized with a rectangular layout and regular distribution. The entrance to the apartment is organized through the corridor which leads to the living room and the kitchen on one side, while on the other side to the bedroom. The apartment has its own balcony accessed from the living room. The apartment is sold invested, including the furniture as in the photo. The building is thermally insulated with a hood system and a facade with terracotta tiles of the highest quality. The thermally insulating windows are triplex glass and extend to the floor, including electric shutters. The facility has its own central park only for residents of the residence, as well as ample parking spaces. The residence is surrounded and there will be monitoring of the space with cameras 24 hours a day. The facility has immediate access to the surrounding expressways, as well as being located very close to the TEG shopping center.
